items.name: Resistive exercise (ARED-class)
items.summary: Heavy resistive training on a vacuum-cylinder device. Reduces, but does not stop, loss.

items.name: Compact flywheel device
items.summary: Lightweight alternative to ARED for small vehicles; effect on bone is less established.

items.name: Vitamin D and calcium management
items.summary: Maintain vitamin D status and calcium intake; supportive, not sufficient alone.

items.name: Anti-resorptive drug (bisphosphonate)
items.summary: Studied with exercise on ISS; may affect post-flight recovery. Flight surgeon decides.
